feature.summary: Web pages that let a company reach the team: /enterprise describes the Enterprise offer and sends visitors to /contact-sales (an email page); /contact drafts an email; /support lists channels; a dialog stores an Enterprise follow-up email; /partners emails partner applications. Mobile About has support links. The CLI has no contact entry found.

purpose.what_it_does: Presents the Enterprise offering and gives several ways to start a conversation: an email address, a mail-draft composer, a stored email request with consent, and a partner application form that emails the team (apps/web/app/enterprise/page.tsx:64-299; apps/web/app/contact-sales/page.tsx; apps/web/app/partners/PartnerApplicationForm.tsx).
purpose.why_it_exists: Enterprise is contract-priced and not self-serve (packages/contracts/types/src/billing-catalog.ts:219-224), and the company states there is no partner program yet but wants to hear from integrators (apps/web/app/partners/page.tsx:68).
purpose.who_uses_it: Company buyers, security reviewers, integration builders, consultancies, and any visitor needing support.
problems_solved: Buyer needs a sales route for SSO, retention and governance
Partner or plugin builder needs a way to apply
Visitor needs honest support channels and response commitments per plan (apps/web/features/marketing/components/pages/company/support-content.ts:13-36)
Consent for storing an email must be recorded (apps/web/app/api/waitlist/public/route.ts:166)
use_cases: A security lead reads /enterprise, clicks Contact sales and emails the sales inbox with team size and review needs (apps/web/app/contact-sales/page.tsx:43-60).
A visitor on /desktop clicks 'Discuss Enterprise access', enters an email, ticks consent and presses 'Request a follow-up' (apps/web/app/desktop/page.tsx:53-56; WaitlistDialog.tsx:116, 172).
A plugin builder fills the partner form and gets a reference like PA-XXXXXXXXXX (apps/web/app/api/partners/apply/route.ts:21-24).
A logged-in user raises a ticket from Settings > Help rather than email (apps/web/app/support/page.tsx:111).

where_to_find_it: Web: footer Product > Enterprise, Company > Partners, Company > Contact, Resources > Support (apps/web/features/marketing/components/system/nav.ts:165-225).
Web: 'Contact sales' on /enterprise and on the Team band of /pricing (enterprise/page.tsx:77, 289; pricing/page.tsx:1206).
Web: 'Discuss Enterprise access' button on /desktop and /mobile hero (desktop/page.tsx:54; mobile/page.tsx:102).

Mobile: About screen > Support section: Help Center, Service Status, Send Feedback, Contact Support (only when signed in and in Cloud mode), Email Support (apps/mobile/app/(app)/about.tsx:115, 275-331).

CLI: /feedback and /bug commands send feedback to the team (apps/cli/src/claude_parity.rs:194-199; apps/cli/src/cloud/feedback.rs:5); one error message points to agiworkforce.com/support (apps/cli/src/errors.rs:1582). No sales or contact page entry found. The brief cites tui_app.rs:3531, which is status-footer code, not a contact entry.
Desktop, VS Code, Chrome: none found.
prerequisites: None for web pages and the dialog.
Mobile Contact Support needs sign-in and Cloud mode (about.tsx:115).
CLI feedback needs the CLI cloud feedback endpoint (apps/cli/src/cloud/feedback.rs:5); sign-in rules not opened.
screens_and_controls: /enterprise: hero with 'Contact sales', sections on identity, policy, audit, retention and compliance, an audit-export sample, closing 'Contact sales' (enterprise/page.tsx:64-299).
/contact-sales: title 'Talk to sales.', 'Email <address>' and 'See what Enterprise includes' buttons, a 'Which door you need' table (contact-sales/page.tsx:43-65).
/contact: Name, Email, Subject, Message fields; the button opens a prefilled draft in the visitor's mail app (contact/page.tsx:17-40, 79).
/support: channels, support-by-tier table, buttons 'Email a bug report', 'Raise a ticket', 'Check service status', 'Open the contact page' (support/page.tsx:99-120).

Enterprise dialog: eyebrow 'Enterprise · contract access', title 'Discuss Enterprise access', Email address, consent checkboxes, submit 'Request a follow-up', close button (WaitlistDialog.tsx:112-176).
/partners: fields Your name, Work email, Company, Website (optional), 'What do you want to build with us?' select, 'Tell us about it', 'Send application' (PartnerApplicationForm.tsx:99-199).
journey: Open /enterprise (or /pricing Enterprise card) and read what is implemented.
Press Contact sales; /contact-sales opens with an email link.
Email the address with team size, surfaces, review needs and timeline.

Or on /desktop or /mobile press 'Discuss Enterprise access', fill email, tick the required consent, press 'Request a follow-up'; the dialog says a person will contact you (WaitlistDialog.tsx:100-110).
Or on /partners press 'Apply to partner', fill the form and send; the page shows 'Application sent.' with the reference (PartnerApplicationForm.tsx:82-86).
feedback_and_outputs: Dialog success: 'You're on the list.' with a withdrawal link to /privacy/requests (WaitlistDialog.tsx:95-110).
Dialog errors: 'Enter a valid email address.' or 'Tick the box agreeing to your email being stored before joining.' (WaitlistDialog.tsx:51-60).
Partner success: reference starting PA- (route.ts:21-24); errors 'Your application was not sent, so nothing reached us. Try again.' and a rate-limit message (PartnerApplicationForm.tsx:16, 67).
settings: Withdrawal of a stored address: /privacy/requests, no account needed (WaitlistDialog.tsx:105-110).

Operator: AGI_SUPPORT_FALLBACK_EMAIL, RESEND_API_KEY and AGI_SUPPORT_FROM_EMAIL decide where partner mail goes and whether it can be sent (apps/web/lib/support/handoff/resend-client.ts:324-334; config.ts:87).

working: /enterprise exists and its Contact sales buttons go to /contact-sales (enterprise/page.tsx:77, 289).
/contact is a mail-draft composer; nothing is sent or stored by the site (contact/page.tsx:30, 79).

The Enterprise dialog validates the email, requires the Enterprise consent, posts through joinPublicWaitlist with consent surface web-waitlist-modal (WaitlistDialog.tsx:51-71) to /api/waitlist/public, which checks CSRF bound to an anonymous session, a rate limit, consent decisions, honours Global Privacy Control, writes the consent ledger and upserts cloud_managed_waitlist on (email, source) (apps/web/app/api/waitlist/public/route.ts:95-198).

The partner form exists, posts to /api/partners/apply and the route checks CSRF, rate limit and schema, then emails the team inbox with a reply-to and returns a reference; it stores nothing in the database (apps/web/app/api/partners/apply/route.ts:27-81). The brief's 'web missing' for S2.37 is out of date.
Partner page states honestly that no partner program exists yet (partners/page.tsx:68).
Mobile About shows Email Support always and Contact Support when signed in on Cloud (about.tsx:115, 313-331).
incomplete: The stored Enterprise request is not on the Enterprise sales path: /enterprise and /pricing go to the email page, while the dialog is opened from /desktop and /mobile (apps/web/app/desktop/page.tsx:53; apps/web/app/mobile/page.tsx:101). Whether other pages mount it is unknown beyond SurfaceSections (features/marketing/components/SurfaceSections.tsx:16).
Partner applications are emailed only; there is no record, status or admin view in the database [inferred from route.ts:27-81].
Developer 'listing' submissions go through the plugin directory, not the partner form (partners/page.tsx text 'List a plugin in the directory'); not opened further.
disconnected_or_disabled: If the email provider is not configured the partner route answers that the application could not be sent (route.ts:68-79; resend-client.ts:327-334).
not_available: CLI: no sales, contact or partner page entry found in apps/cli/src.
Desktop, VS Code, Chrome: nothing found.
Mobile: no sales or partner form.

established.statement: A public page presents the Enterprise offering with a sales path.
A contact or support page lets a visitor reach the company.
A form lets a prospect request an Enterprise conversation and the request is stored.
Partners and developers can submit a listing or partnership application through a form.
Enterprise dialog says a person will contact the visitor about contract-scoped access; consent is required before submit; submit goes through the waitlist client with surface web-waitlist-modal.
Enterprise capabilities are contract scoped and reached through sales; there is no dedicated capacity.

acceptance_criteria: Every Contact sales button on /enterprise and /pricing opens /contact-sales with a working mailto link.
The dialog refuses an invalid email and refuses submit without the required consent, and sends nothing in either case.
A valid dialog submit creates one cloud_managed_waitlist row (idempotent per email and source) and a consent record.
Partner form with fewer than 20 message characters is refused before any request.
A valid partner application returns a PA- reference and an email arrives at the team inbox with reply-to set.
Mobile Contact Support is hidden when signed out or in Local mode.
inferred: The stored Enterprise request should be reachable from the Enterprise page to meet 'the request is stored' for S2.36 [inferred].
proposed: [proposed] Open the Enterprise dialog from /enterprise and /pricing, or state that email is the only route.
[proposed] Store partner applications with a status so none is lost if mail fails.

steps.what_happens: Visitor opens a page; Contact sales is an email link; the composer builds a mailto link in the browser.
Dialog validates email and consent locally.
Client fetches an anonymous-session CSRF token, then POSTs email, source and consent.
Server checks CSRF and rate limit, validates consent, records the consent ledger and upserts the waitlist row.
Partner form POSTs to /api/partners/apply; server validates and sends an email through the email provider.
The email provider delivers the message to the team inbox.

data.retained_or_deleted: unknown (mail retention not in the repository)

execution_and_data_flow.models_and_providers: No AI model takes part. Email delivery uses the email provider behind sendSupportEmail; its name is not recorded here beyond the RESEND_API_KEY setting name.

access_and_usage.account: None required for any web form. Partner route reads an optional signed-in user id (route.ts:36). Mobile Contact Support needs a Clerk sign-in and Cloud mode (about.tsx:115).
access_and_usage.permissions: Anonymous access; CSRF token bound to an anonymous session cookie (waitlist route.ts:80-97).
access_and_usage.subscription: No entitlement is needed. Enterprise itself is contract-priced (billing-catalog.ts:219-224). Support commitments differ by plan: Team first response within 1 business day, Enterprise a named contact (support-content.ts:22-30).
access_and_usage.limits_and_metering: Rate limit bucket 'waitlist' for both waitlist and partner routes (waitlist route.ts:98; partners route.ts:31). Email max 254 characters; partner message 20 to 3000 characters (partner-applications.ts).
access_and_usage.flags: Email provider configuration (RESEND_API_KEY, AGI_SUPPORT_FROM_EMAIL, AGI_SUPPORT_FALLBACK_EMAIL). No feature flag found for the dialog.
access_and_usage.provider_restrictions: Email provider required for partner applications; Global Privacy Control turns optional grants off (waitlist route.ts:119-124).
access_and_usage.local_mode: Not applicable: these are web pages. Mobile Local mode hides Contact Support but Email Support still shows (about.tsx:313-331).

states_and_edge_cases.behaviour: Fields disabled, button reads 'Sending…'; a second submit is ignored.
Error text in a role=alert region; editing clears it.
Client returns 'Failed to join waitlist. Please try again.'; deadlines 10 s for the token and 15 s for the post.
Server returns CONSENT_REQUIRED and stores nothing.
Request refused with an error; nothing stored.
Message about too many applications from this network.
503 style user-safe message 'Your application could not be sent right now...'; error logged as partner_application_undeliverable.
Error text pointing to the address; whether browsers without a handler show it is not handled in the code.
Labelled inputs, alert roles and a close label on the dialog.
A phone marker hides plan and tier content.

existing_tests.covers: Sends the application and shows the reference; asks for missing fields; keeps the form and explains when not sent.
Sends to the team inbox with reply-to and returns a reference; reports undeliverable; refuses incomplete input.
No automatic modal, opens from a trigger, anonymous signup, close, local email validation, service error.
CSRF enforcement, rate limit, anonymous capture.
Token bound to the anonymous session for signed-in and signed-out visitors; no caching.
Email links use the canonical mailto; no mail client opened automatically.

scenarios.name: Dialog consent gate
steps: Enter a valid email, leave the consent box unticked, press 'Request a follow-up'.
scenarios.expected: Message 'Tick the box agreeing...', no network post.

scenarios.name: Dialog stores once
steps: Submit the same email twice from the same page with consent.
scenarios.expected: One cloud_managed_waitlist row for that email and source; two consent entries; success message each time.

scenarios.name: Partner application
steps: Open /partners#apply, fill all required fields with a message over 20 characters, send.
scenarios.expected: Reference PA-... shown; mail arrives at the inbox with reply-to equal to the visitor's address.

scenarios.name: Mail not configured
steps: Run with RESEND_API_KEY unset and submit the partner form.
scenarios.expected: User-safe 'could not be sent' message, nothing delivered.

scenarios.name: Mobile support links
steps: Open Settings > About on mobile signed out, then signed in on Cloud.
scenarios.expected: Email Support always; Contact Support only when signed in on Cloud.

corrections.claim: Rate limit bucket 'waitlist' for both waitlist and partner routes (waitlist route.ts:98; partners route.ts:31)
corrections.what_the_code_shows: POST waitlist and partner apply use 'waitlist', but the waitlist GET token mint uses the 'default' bucket.
corrections.correction: The 'waitlist' bucket covers the waitlist POST and the partner POST; the waitlist token GET uses 'default'.

corrections.claim: Consent refused: server returns CONSENT_REQUIRED and stores nothing
corrections.what_the_code_shows: CONSENT_REQUIRED (400) is returned when a decided purpose is refused. A missing decision gives a validation error instead. Both happen before the ledger or table write, so nothing is stored.
corrections.correction: Refusing the required purpose returns CONSENT_REQUIRED; omitting the decision returns a validation error listing the purpose. Neither stores anything.

missing_facts: The waitlist GET token mint uses rate-limit bucket 'default', not 'waitlist' (apps/web/app/api/waitlist/public/route.ts:82).
Enterprise support has a 4-business-hour service-down response commitment, which section 7 leaves out (apps/web/features/marketing/components/pages/company/support-content.ts:~25-28).

The partner route sends with idempotencyKey partner-application:<reference> and puts the signed-in account id in the email body (apps/web/app/api/partners/apply/route.ts:~58,~96); section 7 mentions only the optional user id.
